title: Messages
lead: Private chats with other writers and readers. Text only.

list.title: Chats
list.empty: No chats yet. Open someone’s profile and choose Message, or start a new chat.
list.requestsHint: First messages from people who don’t follow you show up here. They can’t send more until you accept.
list.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your chats. Try again in a moment.

rules.minors: Adults can never message anyone under 16. If you’re 16 or 17, messages from adults are off unless you turn them on.

audience.everyone: Right now, anyone can message you.
audience.people_i_follow: Right now, only people you follow can message you.
audience.nobody: Right now, nobody can start a new chat with you.

chat.pick: Choose someone on the left, or start a new chat with a writer you follow.
chat.notFound: There’s nobody to message with that username.
chat.loadFailed: We couldn’t load this chat. Try again in a moment.
chat.startHint: Say hello. If {{name}} doesn’t follow you, your first message goes to their requests and you can send more once they accept.
chat.waiting: Your message is waiting in {{name}}’s requests. You can send more once they accept.
chat.textOnly: Text only. You can’t send pictures or files.
chat.noThanksReply: {{name}} replied: “Thanks for writing, but I’d rather not chat right now.”
chat.noThanksAgain: You can send a new request from {{date}}.

share.pick: Pick a chat, or start a new one, to send this link.
share.ready: The link is in the message box. Add a few words, then press Send.

request.title: {{name}} wants to message you
request.explain: They can’t send more until you accept. If you delete the request, they won’t be told.
request.noThanksExplain: “No thanks” sends them a short, kind reply for you, and they can’t ask again for 30 days.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.body: You won’t be able to message, mention or follow each other. {{name}} won’t be told.
block.failed: We couldn’t block them. Try again.

about.title: About this chat
about.adultsHint: Adults can never message anyone under 16. If you’re 16 or 17, messages from adults are off unless you turn them on. Only you can turn this on, in Settings.
about.privacy: Messages aren’t end-to-end encrypted. Our team reads them only if someone reports them or the law requires it.

newChat.title: Start a new chat
newChat.label: Username
newChat.hint: The name after @ on the profile.

failures.not_taking: They aren’t taking messages right now.
failures.too_many: You’ve sent a lot of messages in the last hour. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t do that. Check your connection and try again.

settings.heading: Who can message you
settings.intro: Choose who can start a new chat with you. Chats you already have carry on whatever you pick.
settings.whoLegend: Who can start a chat with you
settings.adultHint: Adults start on “Everyone”. With “Nobody”, nobody can start a new chat with you.
settings.under18Hint: Under 18, you start on “People you follow”. With “Nobody”, nobody can start a new chat with you.
settings.deleteNote: To delete a chat, open it and choose Delete chat in About this chat. When both of you delete it, the messages are deleted for good.
settings.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your message settings. Try again in a moment.
settings.saveFailed: We couldn’t save that. Try again.

deleteChat.title: Delete this chat?
deleteChat.explain: This removes the chat for you. When both of you delete it, the messages are deleted for good.
deleteChat.failed: We couldn’t delete the chat. Try again.

emails.heading: Emails about messages
emails.intro: We can email you when a message or a message request arrives. The email says who wrote, never what they wrote, and it waits 5 minutes, so you get none while you’re chatting here.
emails.emailsLabel: Email me when a message arrives
emails.quietLabel: Quiet hours: hold these emails until morning
emails.quietHint: During quiet hours, emails wait until the hours end. Times are Romanian time.
emails.under18Hint: Under 18, quiet hours stay on. You can move them, as long as they cover 22:00 to 07:00. Times are Romanian time.
emails.saveFailed: We couldn’t save that. Check that the hours start and end at different times, then try again.
emails.under18Refused: We couldn’t save that. Quiet hours need to start by 22:00 and end at 07:00 or later.
